caption_L1: Here a is a area plot titled Number of visitors to cinemas in Germany from 2001 to 2019 (in millions). The y-axis plots Cinema visits in millions while the x-axis plots Year.
caption_L2L3: Overall, the number of visitors to cinemas in Germany fell from 2001 to 2019, from over 150 million to under 125 million. Roughly every five years, there is a spike in visitors to the cinema, in 2004, 2009, 2015 and 2019.
